bgm.prompt: Calm instrumental underscore for a careful drive on a grey rainy afternoon. Soft warm electric piano and gentle airy synth pads, a slow steady pulse like wipers and tyres on wet asphalt, subtle sub bass, sparse muted percussion. Patient, focused and reassuring, never tense or dramatic. Around 72 BPM, even dynamics from start to end, no sudden hits, no vocals, no lead melody that competes with a narrator.
